app.name: Puretasks
app.description: Track project work, review queues, and linked suite resources.

help.says: Adds one task to your open board, or your default one, and says where it went.

createEntities.label: Task board
createEntities.description: Create a new task board package.

tools.name: fn_boardBriefingAndSchedule
tools.description: Build a single-call board briefing for the open PureTasks board: active project context, column loads with WIP limits, overdue/today/tomorrow/this-week schedule buckets, human review queue with wait ages, blocked cards with their unmet blockers, stale in-progress cards, active shell missions, and recent activity.

asOfDate.description: Optional reference date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO) for schedule buckets and ages. Defaults to today.

staleDays.description: Days without update before a non-inbox, non-done card counts as stale. Defaults to 5.

recentActivityLimit.description: Maximum recent activity entries to include. Defaults to 10.

ownerName.description: Optional case-insensitive owner filter to scope the briefing to one person.

tools.name: fn_workloadAndHealthAudit
tools.description: Audit workload balance, WIP limits, time estimates vs logged hours, dependency bottlenecks, and board hygiene across the open PureTasks board. Returns per-owner workload, WIP pressure, label counts, top blocker cards, concrete hygiene findings, and a 0-100 board health score.

asOfDate.description: Optional reference date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO) for overdue checks. Defaults to today.

status.description: Optional column/status id to scope the audit to one column.

tools.name: fn_getTaskDossier
tools.description: Assemble a complete 360-degree dossier for one task card on the open board (defaults to the currently selected task): full card fields, notes, checklist completion breakdown, parent card, subtasks, open and resolved blockers, downstream blocked cards, links, missions, and recent task-scoped activity.

taskId.description: Optional task id from listTasks. Defaults to the currently selected task.

activityLimit.description: Maximum task-scoped activity entries to return. Defaults to 20.

asOfDate.description: Optional reference date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO) for dueBucket calculation. Defaults to today.

tools.name: fn_captureStructuredTask
tools.description: Capture a complete structured work unit on the open board in one atomic write: creates the main task card (with notes, labels, priority, owner, due date, estimates, repeat, reminder, blockers, and resource links) plus optional checklists, child subtasks linked via parentId, and an initial comment. Call getTasksContext first.

subtasks.description: Child cards linked via parentId to the new card.

tools.name: fn_batchTriageTasks
tools.description: Triage, reschedule, reprioritize, reassign, relabel (with non-destructive addLabels/removeLabels), or move multiple task cards in one atomic transaction with optional dryRun preview and triage comments. Enforces column WIP limits unless force is true on an entry.

dryRun.description: Preview diffs and WIP checks without saving.

tools.name: fn_periodReviewDigest
tools.description: Compile a periodic review and completion digest over the open PureTasks board (default 7-day lookback, including recently archived done cards): completed work with hours logged, newly added cards and net throughput, repeating task schedule, upcoming deadlines, carryover in-progress items, and activity volume.

days.description: Lookback window in days for completed and created cards. Defaults to 7.

upcomingDays.description: Lookahead window in days for upcoming open deadlines. Defaults to 7.

asOfDate.description: Optional reference date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO). Defaults to today.

ownerName.description: Optional case-insensitive owner filter to scope the digest.

tools.name: getTasksContext
tools.description: Call this first. Returns the open board (path, draft/filed status, project id, name, description), the current filters, view mode, the selected task id, and task counts. Every other tool resolves ids and columns against this board.

tools.name: listTasks
tools.description: List the cards on the open board as compact rows (no notes, checklists, or comments — use getTask for one full card). Uses the board's current filters unless overridden. Call getTasksContext first.

projectId.description: Optional project id; must be the open board's project (from getTasksContext).

status.description: Optional status/column id filter, or all.

tools.name: getTask
tools.description: Return one full task card, including notes, labels, links, checklists, comments, and timestamps. Defaults to the selected task when taskId is omitted; ids come from listTasks.

taskId.description: Optional task id. Defaults to the selected task.

tools.name: createTask
tools.description: Create a new task card on the open board with optional details, labels, links, owner, due date, priority, column/status, blockedBy, parentId (a subtask), estimateHours, repeat and remindAt. A column at its WIP limit refuses new cards. Call getTasksContext first; column ids come from listTaskColumns. Returns the new card's id and a compact summary (column, priority, labels, dates, counts of comments/checklists/links), not the whole card; getTask returns the full card.

projectId.description: Optional project id; must be the open board's project (from getTasksContext). Defaults to it.

status.description: Optional column/status id. Defaults to inbox.

dueAt.description: Due date as YYYY-MM-DD or ISO string.

type.description: Kind of resource. Defaults to file.

title.description: Display title. Defaults to the path or resource id.

path.description: Filesystem path of the resource, if it is a file or package.

appSlug.description: App that opens the resource, e.g. writer or book.

resourceId.description: App-defined resource id, for resources that are not files.

links.description: Resource links to attach (the origin of the work, related files).

blockedBy.description: Ids of cards this one waits on; the block clears when they are all done.

parentId.description: The card this one is a subtask of; null detaches it.

remindAt.description: ISO date-time for a reminder; null clears it.

tools.name: updateTask
tools.description: Edit, move, or reorder a task card on the open board. Call getTasksContext first. Omitted fields are preserved; status moves the card to that column (ids from listTaskColumns) and beforeTaskId places it within the column — a move into a column at its WIP limit is refused unless force is true. Also sets blockedBy (cards it waits on), parentId (subtask of), estimateHours, loggedHours, repeat (daily/weekly/monthly; a done card comes back with the next due date) and remindAt. Task ids come from listTasks. Returns the card's compact summary (id, column, order, fields, counts of comments/checklists/links), not the whole card; getTask returns the full card.

beforeTaskId.description: Optional task id to place this task before within the target column.

type.description: Kind of resource. Defaults to file.

title.description: Display title. Defaults to the path or resource id.

path.description: Filesystem path of the resource, if it is a file or package.

appSlug.description: App that opens the resource, e.g. writer or book.

resourceId.description: App-defined resource id, for resources that are not files.

links.description: Replaces the card's resource links when given; use addTaskResourceLink/removeTaskResourceLink to change one link.

blockedBy.description: Ids of cards this one waits on; the block clears when they are all done.

parentId.description: The card this one is a subtask of; null detaches it.

remindAt.description: ISO date-time for a reminder; null clears it.

force.description: Move into a column that is at its WIP limit anyway.

tools.name: createMissionFromTask
tools.description: Turn a card into an assignment the shell runs (the card's own “Create assignment” button). kind: 'do' works the task and moves it to Review, 'steps' writes a checklist only, 'draft' writes the first draft of the linked document, 'dependencies' links what the card waits on. The assignment's progress shows on the card (getTask.missions). Use when the user asks for the work to be done or planned by an assignment; never also do the work yourself. Requires approval: starts an assignment.

tools.name: deleteTaskProject
tools.description: PERMANENTLY delete a board package by path (from listTaskProjects) — the folder is removed outright, with no Trash and no snapshot to restore. Call getTasksContext first. Refuses the open board; open or create another board first. Only on an explicit user instruction that names the board.

path.description: Package path of the board to delete, from listTaskProjects. Cannot be the open board.

tools.name: discoverAppTools
tools.description: Discover PureTasks's extended specialist tools (22 tools across activity, board, checklists, columns, comments, links, projects, tasks) and composite functions (6 workflows). Prefer calling exposed composite functions and core tools first; use discoverAppTools when an edge case needs a specialist tool, then call it via callExtendedReadTool (for read-only tools) or callExtendedTool (for mutating tools).

query.description: Optional keywords describing the capability you need (e.g. "activity", "board", "checklists", "columns", "comments").

category.description: Optional category filter (activity, board, checklists, columns, comments, links, projects, tasks, or "all").

names.description: Optional exact tool names to fetch full JSON input schemas for.

includeFunctions.description: Include already-exposed composite functions and core tools in the listing (default false: searches extended tools first).

tools.name: callExtendedReadTool
tools.description: Call one of PureTasks's read-only extended specialist tools discovered via discoverAppTools (categories: activity, board, checklists, columns, comments, links, projects, tasks). Strictly refuses mutating, destructive, external, or release tools.

tool.description: Exact name of a read-only extended tool from discoverAppTools.

arguments.description: Arguments object matching the tool’s inputSchema.

tools.name: callExtendedTool
tools.description: Call one of PureTasks's mutating extended specialist tools discovered via discoverAppTools (categories: activity, board, checklists, columns, comments, links, projects, tasks). For destructive tools, set confirmDestructive: true after checking with the user. Strictly refuses read-only tools (use callExtendedReadTool), external tools, permanent-delete tools, and release tools.

tool.description: Exact name of a mutating extended tool from discoverAppTools.

arguments.description: Arguments object matching the tool’s inputSchema.

confirmDestructive.description: Required (true) when calling an extended tool marked risk: "destructive".
